subject: Procurement next steps & timeline for BlueWave pilot
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samantha Kent <samantha.kent@bluewave-payments.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Procurement next steps & timeline for BlueWave pilot

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and a proposed path so we can align your internal stakeholders and keep the pilot on a Nov–Dec cadence: 

Summary of ask
- Pilot: 2-week pilot for routing evaluation (peak and tail latency) with 100k tokens/day simulated load
- Data: no sensitive PII in trial traffic; we will route logs to your S3 for retention

Procurement path (suggested milestones)
1) Legal review of the MPA (you indicated 1–2 weeks) — owner: BlueWave legal (Marco)
2) Security checklist & SOC2 evidence (concurrent) — owner: BlueWave security (procurement@...)
3) Finance review & PO decision (PO vs card vs marketplace) — owner: BlueWave finance (Samantha)
4) PO issuance or marketplace onboarding — target: PO by 2027-12-06

To help, I attached a draft MPA and a one-pager SLA summary. Can you confirm:
- Which procurement route is preferred (PO / corporate card / AWS Marketplace)?
- Who is the formal legal lead and security lead to route the redlines and SOC2 evidence to?
- Any internal blackout dates in late Nov we should avoid?

Next actions I propose from Redwood
- Ben will prepare a redline-ready MSA + short comment summary for your counsel (2 business days)
- Vanessa will share an onboarding checklist and a marketplace vs PO cost comparison (by EOD tomorrow)

If that looks right, can you loop in Marco (legal) and procurement@bluewave-payments so we have the owners on the thread? Thanks — I’ll stand by to accelerate once we have owners.

Best,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

From: Samantha Kent <samantha.kent@bluewave-payments.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: procurement@bluewave-payments.com, Marco Diaz <marco.diaz@bluewave-payments.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 11:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Procurement next steps & timeline for BlueWave pilot

Thanks Jonas — good summary. Looping in Marco and procurement. A few clarifications from our side:

- Procurement route: Finance prefers a PO but marketplace onboarding is an option if legal signs off quickly. We will default to PO unless Marketplace is materially faster.
- Legal lead: Marco Diaz (cc’d) — he will own the MPA review. Expect initial comments in ~5 business days.
- Security / compliance: procurement@bluewave-payments will coordinate SOC2 and SSO requirements. We need clarifications on data residency and retention windows (default 30 days?)
- Blackout: Thanksgiving week for our finance team (Nov 22–26) — might push PO issuance into early Dec if legal takes full review time.

On evidence: please send SOC2 report (PDF) and your standard encryption/KMS write-up. Also confirm whether Redwood supports customer-managed KMS for the pilot.

Happy to keep to your proposed milestones but please assume a 1-week delay for legal during the Thanksgiving window.

—
Samantha Kent
Head of Platform Ops, BlueWave Payments
samantha.kent@bluewave-payments.com
[External Attachment: BlueWave_procurement_template.docx (docx)]

On Wed, Nov 16, 2027 at 11:47 AM Samantha Kent <samantha.kent@bluewave-payments.com> wrote:
> Thanks Jonas — good summary. Looping in Marco and procurement. A few clarifications from our side:
> 
> - Procurement route: Finance prefers a PO but marketplace onboarding is an option if legal signs off quickly.
> - Legal lead: Marco Diaz (cc’d) — he will own the MPA review. Expect initial comments in ~5 business days.
> - Security / compliance: procurement@bluewave-payments will coordinate SOC2 and SSO requirements.

Thanks — appreciate the quick orientation. A few items from our side to make the legal/security reviews fast:

1) SOC2 & security evidence
- Vanessa: attaching our SOC2 report and an internal KMS integration note. We do support customer-managed KMS for Private deployments; for the Hosted path we can provide HSM-backed KMS integrations. See attachment.

2) Proposed milestone calendar (updated for Thanksgiving week):
- 11/17 — Redwood provides SOC2 + KMS note (done, attached)
- 11/18–11/23 — Marco & legal: initial MPA review window (note: Thanksgiving week may reduce review capacity)
- 11/24–11/30 — Security checklist completion and technical Q&A (Redwood & BlueWave security)
- 12/01–12/05 — Finance signoff & PO issuance (target)
- 12/06 — Kickoff for pilot provisioning (if PO issued)

3) Docs / assets I attached:
- redwood_mpa_v0.3.docx (initial draft, Ben will prepare a redline-ready copy)
- redwood_sla_onepager.pdf (SLA summary)
- redwood_soc2_excerpt.pdf (SOC2 summary + link to full report under NDA)

Ben / Vanessa — can you confirm: Ben will seed a clean MSA + redline tracker for Marco; Vanessa will send the marketplace vs PO cost delta and a one-page onboarding checklist. Also confirm that the default data retention for Hosted test traffic is 30 days unless otherwise configured.

Samantha / Marco — please confirm the legal and security owners for any additional folks we should include.

Best,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marco Diaz <marco.diaz@bluewave-payments.com>, Samantha Kent <samantha.kent@bluewave-payments.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Nov 2027 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Procurement next steps & timeline for BlueWave pilot

Thanks all — quick confirmation from Redwood side.

- I will produce a redline-ready MSA (clean copy + comments) and a short change-log for Marco by EOD Monday (11/22).
- Vanessa will circulate the PO vs Marketplace cost delta and onboarding checklist by tomorrow EOD.
- Data retention: default for Hosted pilot is 30 days; we can adjust to 7/90 on written request — note this will affect log retention costs.

Proposed sprint-style mutual action plan (MAP) — high level
- Week A (11/22–11/26): Legal initial review (Marco) + Redwood prepares redline MSA
- Week B (11/29–12/03): Security Q&A & evidence exchange
- Week C (12/06): Finance approves & issues PO (target)

If Thanksgiving shifts Marco’s timeline, we’ll treat Week A as sliding — the MAP is flexible but we prefer not to push provisioning past 12/10 to keep the pilot momentum.

If everyone is good with these owners and dates, I’ll upload the redline and tracker to the HubSpot deal and send a DocuSign for the MPA when legal signs off.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
